# erga-hic-collapsed-scaffoldingqc-yahs-v2311-wf4

## Overview

This workflow is designed for the European Reference Genome Atlas ([ERGA](https://www.erga-biodiversity.eu/)) initiative to perform Hi-C scaffolding on collapsed assemblies. It takes a purged GFA file and paired-end Hi-C reads as primary inputs, along with a Meryl database and lineage information for downstream evaluation.

The core scaffolding process begins by converting the input GFA to FASTA and aligning Hi-C reads using [BWA-MEM2](https://github.com/bwa-mem2/bwa-mem2). These alignments are processed through [Bellerophon](https://github.com/sc932/Bellerophon) for filtering and merging before being passed to [YaHS](https://github.com/c-zhou/yahs) (Yet Another Hi-C Scaffolder). YaHS utilizes the Hi-C contact information to orient and join contigs into scaffolds, producing the final FASTA and AGP files.

Comprehensive quality control and visualization are integrated throughout the pipeline. [PretextMap](https://github.com/wtsi-hpag/PretextMap) and Pretext Snapshot generate visual contact maps to validate the scaffolding results. Assembly integrity and completeness are further assessed using [BUSCO](https://busco.ezlab.org/), [Merqury](https://github.com/marbl/merqury), and [gfastats](https://github.com/galaxyproject/tools-iuc/tree/master/tools/gfastats), ensuring the final output meets high-quality reference genome standards.

## Inputs and data preparation

| Step | Label | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Purged GFA | data_input | gfa assembly file to scaffold |
| 1 | HiC F trimmed | data_input | HiC forward reads (already trimmed) |
| 2 | HiC R trimmed | data_input | HiC reverse reads (already trimmed) |
| 3 | Estimated genome size | data_input |  |
| 4 | lineage | parameter_input | lineage for BUSCO, e.g.: arthropoda_odb10, vertebrata_odb10, mammalia_odb10, aves_odb10, tetrapoda_odb10 ... |
| 5 | Meryl database | data_input |  |


Ensure your purged assembly is in GFA format and HiC reads are provided as separate forward and reverse FASTQ datasets for the BWA-MEM2 mapping steps. You must also provide a pre-computed Meryl database and the specific BUSCO lineage to ensure accurate k-mer and completeness QC. While individual datasets are standard, using collections for paired HiC reads can simplify management when processing multiple samples. Refer to the README.md for comprehensive parameter descriptions and specific data preparation requirements. You can use `planemo workflow_job_init` to generate a `job.yml` template for automated execution.

## How to run (Planemo)

### Local Galaxy (default engine)

```bash
planemo run Galaxy-Workflow-ERGA_HiC_Collapsed_Scaffolding_QC_YaHS_v2311_(WF4).ga job.yml --download_outputs --output_directory . --output_json output.json
```

Optional: `--galaxy_root /path/to/galaxy` speeds up spinning up a local Galaxy.

### Docker Galaxy

Append e.g. `--engine docker_galaxy --ignore_dependency_problems` (requires Docker).

### External Galaxy (usegalaxy.org / EU / …)

```bash
planemo run Galaxy-Workflow-ERGA_HiC_Collapsed_Scaffolding_QC_YaHS_v2311_(WF4).ga job.yml --engine external_galaxy --galaxy_url SERVER_URL --galaxy_user_key YOUR_API_KEY
```

Create a reusable profile: `planemo profile_create myprofile --galaxy_url ... --galaxy_user_key ... --engine external_galaxy` then `planemo run Galaxy-Workflow-ERGA_HiC_Collapsed_Scaffolding_QC_YaHS_v2311_(WF4).ga job.yml --profile myprofile`.

### Job file

- Generate a template: `planemo workflow_job_init Galaxy-Workflow-ERGA_HiC_Collapsed_Scaffolding_QC_YaHS_v2311_(WF4).ga -o job.yml`
- Lint: `planemo workflow_lint Galaxy-Workflow-ERGA_HiC_Collapsed_Scaffolding_QC_YaHS_v2311_(WF4).ga`

See **[Running Galaxy workflows](https://planemo.readthedocs.io/en/master/running.html)** in the Planemo documentation.

## Invocation outputs

After a successful run with `--download_outputs`, files appear under your chosen `--output_directory`. `--output_json` records CWL-style metadata for outputs (paths, checksums).

On an external Galaxy, use `planemo invocation_download INVOCATION_ID --profile ...` to fetch outputs, or track progress with `planemo workflow_track INVOCATION_ID`.

Workflow steps marked as **workflow outputs** in the editor are listed under **Workflow outputs**; exact filenames depend on tools and Galaxy configuration.

## Files

- `Galaxy-Workflow-ERGA_HiC_Collapsed_Scaffolding_QC_YaHS_v2311_(WF4).ga` — Galaxy workflow export (JSON)
- `job.yml` — inputs/parameters for `planemo run` (create with `planemo workflow_job_init`)
